svg.title: 教师 GRU 的量化校准、Boolean 编译及自主状态反馈
svg.desc: RecurBool direct-conversion pipeline, illustrated by the frozen W5S5-I8 instance: five-bit weight, state, gate, candidate and score codes; eight-bit product, per-level accumulator and affine words; static metadata counted separately. Labeled dashed callouts relate the finite model to its state-quantization inset and the compiled circuit C to autonomous recurrent deployment. H and V denote hidden size and vocabulary size; the depicted text8 interface uses H=256 and V=27. Example values are illustrative, not measured parameters. This figure describes quantization and compilation rather than differentiable gate-network training.

text.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
